summary: Regression verification of image loading bug fix in /app/backend/routers/upload_router.py (asyncio.to_thread wrapping of blocking storage calls). VERIFIED: images now load correctly across Gallery, Home, all room categories, tile detail, lightbox, and admin panel. 0/72 gallery image requests failed. Bug is FIXED. However images are slow to fully paint (23-30s for last images on cold gallery load).

minor.issue: Slow individual response times under concurrent load (some medium.webp took 23-30s to complete when 72 images are requested concurrently on Gallery). All return HTTP 200; no failures. Likely due to Emergent object-storage latency serialized through thread pool. Consider adding an in-process LRU cache for hot images or streaming responses.

issues: During initial cold load (first ~10s) the greige placeholder color of image tiles matches the page background, which is what the user perceived as 'blank/failed images'. Consider a skeleton shimmer or spinner overlay so users get visual load feedback while the 23-30s tail-latency images arrive.

action_items: (Optional performance) Add server-side caching (LRU/disk) for /api/media/{path} responses to avoid re-fetching from object storage on every request; ETag/If-None-Match support would also help.
(Optional UX) Replace static greige placeholder with a skeleton loader / spinner in DemoPhotoCard so cold-loads don't visually resemble a failure.
(No functional fix required) Bug reported by user is resolved; the asyncio.to_thread fix + import + logger.error changes are all in place and verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: upload_router.py fix is correctly applied: `import asyncio` present at line 1, `await asyncio.to_thread(process_and_upload_image,...)` at line 25, `await asyncio.to_thread(get_object,...)` at line 43, and except blocks now use logger.error to surface real errors instead of silent swallow.

Consider adding an on-disk or in-memory cache in storage.get_object for repeated media serving; each request currently re-fetches from Emergent object storage even though the frontend sets Cache-Control: max-age=31536000.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: Gallery page renders all 72 real photos, 0 failed /api/media/ requests observed across full test session (Gallery, Home, /tiles/{bathroom,kitchen,living,outdoor,wall,floor}, /tile/alpine-white-marble-nu-gvt-101, lightbox, admin tiles list). Load times observed: 1 img @3s, 9 @15s, 17 @20s, 71 @30s, 72 @45s — all succeed. Screenshot at .screenshots/gallery_final.png shows all real showroom photos. Admin login + admin/tiles works and thumbnails render 18/18. Bug is resolved; only remaining concerns are performance (slow tail latency) and UX (placeholder color = bg color).
rca of the issue: Root cause: FastAPI async route handlers `GET /api/media/{path}` and `POST /api/admin/upload` were calling synchronous `requests`-based storage functions (get_object / process_and_upload_image) directly, blocking the single event-loop thread. Under Gallery cold-load (~70 concurrent image requests) this fully starved the loop, causing image requests and even unrelated /api endpoints to stall or intermittently fail. Fix: wrap blocking calls in `await asyncio.to_thread(...)`. Secondary issue: initial patch dropped `import asyncio`, and the bare `except Exception` in serve_media silently converted the resulting NameError into a generic 404 'Image not found', masking the real problem. Both are now fixed and verified working end-to-end via browser: 0 failed /api/media/ requests, all 72 gallery images visually render.
